# "Test calendar" button, one broken entry no longer breaks the whole calendar
### New
- **"Test calendar" at each frame** (*Devices → ⚙ → Calendar*): checks link, user and password (even before saving) and names the reason when it fails ("user or password do not match", "there is no calendar at this link" …). On success it shows the calendar's **readable name** (for example "Family" instead of the long Radicale address), the number of entries and how many are due today and tomorrow. The name also appears when you open the dialog.
### Fixed
- **A single broken entry made the whole calendar unreadable:** an old appointment with an unreadable `SEQUENCE` crashed the full appointment reader, and only the simple reader (without monthly repeats and exceptions) was left. Broken side attributes are now ignored, and only an entry with an unreadable date or repeat rule is skipped.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
